note: What the harness needs installed and connected, by workload profile. `core` always applies; the planner adds the profiles a spec calls for. `version` is the release this configuration was last verified against; null means no version was recorded and scripts/doctor.py reports it as unpinned. Each plugin is taken from exactly one marketplace.
